title: Who knew they could all be so different!

author: carwow
description:
The all-new Audi Q7 has been revealed, and we’re going to explore the exterior and interior changes, coupled with the back seat space, the engine choices, and the price. 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-04-07

This is the all-new Audi Q7! 

Audi’s competitor to the BMW X7 and Mercedes GLS has had a full design refresh, and Mat’s flown over to Germany to see what’s changed. So what exactly is new? Let’s get into it… 

Starting with the exterior design, it’s fair to say that the new Q7 certainly stands out. Up front there’s a huge, illuminated grille, and this is flanked by a pair of OLED headlights. It’s also worth noting that the headlights are absolutely fantastic - there are several different light signatures, and the full beams can act as a projector when you approach/walk away from the car!
